mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id AS tenantId,job_type AS jobType,job_key AS jobKey,status,retry_count AS retryCount,version FROM crm_followup_schedule_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_type=#{jobType} AND job_key=#{jobKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_followup_schedule_job SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{leaseOwner},lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND (status='READY' OR (status='FAILED' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=#{now})) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at<=#{now}))
